dct_creator_sm: Population Research Laboratory (University of Alberta Population Research Laboratory, Department of Sociology, University of Alberta).
dct_description_sm:
This survey of households across the province of Alberta continues to enable academic researchers, government departments, and non-profit organizations to explore a wide range of topics in a
structured research framework and environment. Sponsors research questions are asked together with demographic questions in a telephone interview of Alberta households.
dct_rights_sm: This dataset is made available with limited information on how it can be used. You may wish to communicate with the Contact(s) specified before use.
